synergy: Sewer Lord spawns rat tokens every shop phase — each one passively stacks Leviathan's +1/+1 buff without spending any actions.

Bile Spitter gives a friendly Murloc Poisonous. Diremuck Forager gives divine shield — protect your poisonous attacker so it survives long enough to one-shot the enemy's best minion.
